note: Synthetic and illustrative. No stage in this mission has produced a real run artifact; this fixture exists to demonstrate what a complete, passing report looks like once one does.

failure_cases.segment: cold-start users at exactly 5 interactions (the eligibility boundary)
failure_cases.observation: nDCG@10 for this exact-boundary group trails the rest of the personalized cohort by roughly 4 points, even though the group average clears the cold-start guardrail.
failure_cases.hypothesis: the boundary is a step function: a user with 4 interactions gets pure popularity, a user with 5 gets the full model with almost no signal advantage over popularity yet.

failure_cases.segment: queries where the lexical queue returns fewer than 3 candidates
failure_cases.observation: final nDCG@10 for these queries is close to the popularity baseline rather than the mission mean.
failure_cases.hypothesis: recall union is starved on rare-token queries, so fine-rank and the value tree are reordering a nearly-popularity-shaped candidate set with little to work with.
